source: oa-ca alerts.csv + oa-encounter encounters.csv from the same OAF clip
hour_bins: UTC half-open [hour_start,hour_end); event assigned once by onset
pair_identity: unordered pair of canonical uppercase eight-hex-digit aircraft addresses
episode_overlap: closed intervals overlap when max(start_a,start_b) <= min(end_a,end_b)
encounter_proxy: known-altitude oa-encounter record-volume episode: horizontal < 5 NM and vertical < 1000 ft
alert_proxy: oa-ca alert episode; these are CA outputs, not operator presentation acknowledgements
true_alert_match: same unordered pair and closed interval overlap with a known-altitude encounter episode
truth_unknown: ALT_UNKNOWN encounters are unresolved, never a hit or a nuisance label
warning_rate: matched known-altitude encounter episodes divided by resolved known-altitude encounter episodes (matches + misses); unresolved cases are reported separately
nuisance_rate: covered unmatched alert episode count per covered evaluation hour; unresolved alert episodes are reported separately
warmup: 120 seconds after the first usable clip time; only episodes beginning before first_usable_time + 120 seconds lack earlier tracker context
local_coverage: clip-edge gaps affect only episode intervals they intersect; later fully covered hours remain eligible despite an earlier warmup gap; each hour reports covered seconds and only covered hours enter nuisance-rate exposure
right_censoring: an episode ending at or after clip coverage end is reported right-censored and cannot be a negative miss or nuisance label; count it in its onset hour
unresolved: unknown-altitude labels, any unevaluated episode, global run shortfalls, event onset before usable warmup, and event ending at/after clip coverage end remain unresolved; these conditions never become nuisance alerts or misses
coverage: global oa-ca and oa-encounter summary shortfalls remain conservative gates; clip-boundary completeness is checked per episode and per hour
adapter_limits: 200000 episode rows per CSV, 512 MiB per CSV, and 10000000 same-pair interval comparisons; exceedance refuses the aggregate
privacy: inputs and outputs pass the production sealed-path guard; input files must be regular, single-link files; output is a new private directory with create-new 0600 aggregate files
claim_limit: literal ADS-B-derived encounter-volume coincidence proxy only; not independent truth, FAA/human truth, or facility false-alert qualification
